patterns.note: Content sections are consistently centered with a maximum width, creating clear visual boundaries and ample whitespace on the sides.
Headings utilize a large, bold sans-serif typeface for strong visual impact and hierarchy, contrasting with a lighter weight sans-serif for body text.
The design primarily uses a high-contrast black and white palette, with various shades of dark gray for secondary text and subtle background variations.
The top announcement bar slides up and disappears upon scroll, while the main navigation bar becomes sticky and slightly reduces its height.
The footer is a highly stylized, graphically rich section enclosed within a large, organically rounded shape, featuring playful, hand-drawn-like illustrations and text.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky navigation bar that dynamically shrinks in height and removes a preceding announcement bar as the user scrolls down the page.
Content is structured using generous vertical padding between sections, establishing a clear visual rhythm and separating distinct blocks of information.
The footer is implemented as a unique, immersive graphic element, using a dark background with white, illustrative elements and text, contained within a large, irregularly rounded container.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~2-3x body text) provide strong hierarchy, complemented by smaller, legible sans-serif body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons and image containers, contrasting with the very large, organic, and irregular rounded corners of the footer section.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, with generous vertical padding between sections and within content blocks, creating a spacious and uncluttered feel.

standout: The most distinctive element is the highly creative and playful footer, which breaks from the clean, minimal aesthetic of the rest of the page. Its large, organically rounded shape, 'hand-drawn' graphic elements, and 'Become a Mechanic' call to action give it a unique, almost sticker-like quality that is memorable and engaging.
